name: redmine
description: Redmine MCP server (issues, projects, time tracking, wiki, redmine_expert_helpdesk, redmine_expert_agile, RedmineUP) acting as a dedicated Redmine user, read-only by default.

redmine_url.title: Redmine URL
redmine_url.description: Base URL of the Redmine instance, e.g. https://redmine.example.com

redmine_api_key.title: API key of the Redmine user
redmine_api_key.description: API access key of the dedicated Redmine user (My account -> API access key). Its permissions limit everything the server can see and do.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: On: no tools that change Redmine are offered and every non-GET request is blocked. Off: issues, time entries, wiki pages etc. can be created and changed.

toolsets.title: Toolsets
toolsets.description: Comma separated: standard, expert_helpdesk, expert_agile, redmineup, or all. Generic read access to every resource is always available.

verify_ssl.title: Verify TLS certificates
verify_ssl.description: Turn off only for instances with self-signed certificates.
